headline: Public hearing on appeal of fence approval at 65 Green Acres Drive; parking lot expansion at 43 Starr Farm Road.
summary: An appeal of an administrative approval for a vinyl privacy fence and picket fence is on the agenda. Another item proposes expanding an existing parking lot at 43 Starr Farm Road.
items: Public hearing on ZAP-26-15, appeal of administrative approval ZPF-26-80 for vinyl privacy fence and picket fence at 65 Green Acres Drive
Certificate of appropriateness for ZP-26-536, proposed expansion of existing parking lot at 43 Starr Farm Road
